method: Exact solid intersections at <=0.5 mm hardware increments; relative-pose cache and bounding-box rejection. Covers angled axle extraction and parking, roller and motor removal, the chassis slide and tray withdrawal, and lower bearing hardware removal. Sampled geometry, not a continuous proof.

output_through_hole_update.method: Rebuilt solid equals previously checked rack minus four output clearance cylinders; exact symmetric-difference check. Whole geometry-generator comparison confirms no other geometry or kinematics changed. Material removal cannot introduce part interference; prior motion, mesh, guide, enclosure and service checks are retained, not rerun.
